reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Assigning a category without the structured interview.
Using the highest rather than the lowest category indicated.
name: Extended Glasgow Outcome Scale

version.label: GOSE, eight categories (Wilson et al. 1998)
version.detail: Splits severe disability, moderate disability and good recovery into lower and upper bands. Categories only: the copyrighted structured interview used to assign them is not reproduced.

purpose: Global functional outcome after brain injury, with finer categories than the GOS.
intendedPopulation: Adults after traumatic or non-traumatic acute brain injury.

calculatorNotice.title: Assign with the structured interview
calculatorNotice.message: GOSE categories should be assigned using the official structured interview (Wilson et al. 1998), which is not reproduced here. This tool records the category only.

inputDefinitions.label: GOSE category
inputDefinitions.help: Overall rating is the lowest category indicated across the interview.

resultStates.label: Upper good recovery
resultStates.summary: Outcome category: upper good recovery at this assessment.
resultStates.detail: Describes global outcome; it does not exclude all injury-related problems.

clinicalContext.text: A standard outcome measure in traumatic brain injury research.

clinicalInsights.text: Record the timepoint, information source and whether the structured interview was used.

limitations.text: Reliability depends on the structured interview, which is not included here.

limitations: Reflects disability from all causes, not only the brain injury.

confounders.effect: Can lower the category independently of the brain injury.

guideSections.what: An eight-category extension of the Glasgow Outcome Scale.
guideSections.whenToUse: Outcome assessment after brain injury, particularly in research.
guideSections.howToPerform: Use the official structured interview; the overall rating is the lowest category indicated. Record the category here.
guideSections.clinicalContext: An outcome measure; it does not describe acute severity.

sources.citation: Wilson JTL, Pettigrew LEL, Teasdale GM. Structured interviews for the Glasgow Outcome Scale and the extended Glasgow Outcome Scale: guidelines for their use. J Neurotrauma. 1998;15(8):573-585.
Jennett B, Bond M. Assessment of outcome after severe brain damage. Lancet. 1975;1(7905):480-484.
